result.summary: The corrected invoice NBL-025-INV-15 now has the right postcode, but it shows no price, VAT, total or work date. No quote was ever received and the landlord approved no amount. I can't send the invoice for payment yet, so I've asked the contractor for a priced invoice and their findings. I've asked the tenant whether the plumber attended, whether the drip has stopped and whether the water is still cloudy. I've told the landlord the invoice is on hold until we have an amount. A hold is set with a 3-day follow-up. I also escalated at low priority because the landlord's approval isn't recorded in the CRM, which blocks the stage move. The new drawer repair and the boiler query in the handover need someone to pick them up.
